generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's shrub species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Jepson eFlora's account of the family, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): calyx teeth (2)5; corolla small, radial, rotate, (3-4)5-lobed; stamens 5, rarely 4, on the corolla; ovary more or less inferior, 1- or 3- to 5-chambered. Abrams and Ferris (volume 4, read in full) give the elders' corolla rotate and regular and the ovary 3- to 5-celled.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 306 Adoxaceae (moschatel), with the elders and viburnums he still keeps in Caprifoliaceae, which APG joins as Viburnaceae (Adoxaceae): leaves opposite; fruit a drupe.
